description.value:
Made for Militech’s AT units, the Basilisk-Stinger is a highly accurate, shoulder-fired vehicle obliterator. It’s more or less a heavy missile launcher put into a cybergrunt-portable platform. In other words, powerful.

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Rocket Launcher • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Mis. Launcher

Damage: 8d6 • Capacity: 1 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Explosive

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Long Tube, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: This weapon’s targeting system allows it to fire Smart Ammunition without requiring Targeting Scope cyberware. When dealing damage to a vehicle via Improved Smart Ammunition with this weapon, any damage die that land on a 1 are re-rolled until they result in a higher value. One Improved Smart Rocket is included with purchase.

Range: Mis. Launcher
Pre-installed: Long Tube, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Explosive

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
